name: The Cursed Cavalcade

specialRules.name: Foolish Nobleness
specialRules.text: The Cursed Cavalcade is treated as an Evil warband and, like the Cult of the Possessed, for all game effect purposes (e.g. effect 333 - Prisoners, on the exploration chart). They cannot hire any Hired Sword or Dramatis Personae other than the Crow Master and anyone that specifically says otherwise.

specialRules.name: Capture!
specialRules.text: If a Hero takes Out of Action an enemy human Henchman model with a Misericordia, and you have less than 5 Captured Thralls, roll a die: on a 9+ the model is captured. Enemy Heroes can only be captured as a result of '61 - Captured!' on the Serious Injuries table. No more than 2 models can be captured per game. If you already captured 2 henchmen, or already have 5 Captured Thralls, reroll any '61 - Captured!' result for the heroes.

specialRules.name: The Throne of Worms
specialRules.text: For each enemy captured, instead of rolling on the Serious Injury table after the battle, roll 1d12: 1-2 swallowed forever, remove the warrior from the original warband's roster. 3-11 loses his mind, remove the warrior from the original roster and you gain a Captured Thrall. 12 sacrificed, remove the warrior from the original roster and a random Hero in your warband gains 1 XP. Replaces any other way a captured model is treated, including '61 - Captured!' on the heroes' injury table.

specialRules.name: Cursed Masks
specialRules.text: When you hire a Hero during warband creation you may give him a special mask for free. Each mask is unique (only 1 of each kind in the warband at a time) and cannot be removed once applied. After warband creation, you may buy masks for each hero without one in the post-match sequence at the listed price.

equipmentLists.name: Heroes equipment list
equipmentLists.usedBy: Aristocrat, Companions, Twisted Scholar, Cursed Piper

items.name: Misericordia
items.note: Rare 9. Strength as user; Coup de grace: indescribable pain but does not kill the target outright; when attacking knocked down opponents it bypasses all armour saves.

items.name: Boar Spear
items.note: Aristocrat only. Rare 10. Equipment list prints 30 gc, the item description prints 20 gc. Strength as user +1; Strike First (first turn of combat even when charged), Cavalry Bonus (+1 S on the turn a mounted wielder charges), Cross Guard (when charged, reduces first assailant's attacks by 1 down to a minimum of 1; base stats unaffected), Unwieldy (only a shield or buckler in the other hand).

items.name: Cathayan Quilted Silk Armor
items.note: Rare 10. Adds +1 to the armour saves against any type of attack; can be combined with any other armour.

items.name: Nightmare
items.note: Aristocrat only. Rare 11. Undead steed: M8 WS2 BS0 S3 T3 W1 I2 A1 Ld5. May not run (may charge); immune to poison; immune to psychology, never takes Leadership tests, always stands still if left leaderless; rider rolls on the Whoa Boy! table if wounded.

items.name: Bird of Prey
items.note: Aristocrat only. Rare 10. Used in the shooting phase like a missile weapon: range 18", no line of sight needed (not against hidden targets), ignores penalties for moving, long range and cover; uses owner's BS; Strength 4 hit.

items.name: Sun King Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask, Aristocrat only. Wearer cannot be knocked down or stunned, nor by effects or Injury table results.

items.name: Silver Death Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask. If wearer is taken Out of Action he may reroll any Serious Injury result, accepting the second.

items.name: Fish Head Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask. Each time wearer takes an opponent Out of Action he regains a lost wound or gains an additional wound up to a maximum of 5, lasting to end of battle.

items.name: Faceless Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask. Wearer may stop one model from Intercepting his charge once per game. Models immune to psychology (Undead, Flagellants) are unaffected by this.

items.name: Plague Doctor Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask, Twisted Scholar only. Once per game in the shooting phase, unleash a black cloud: first turn it hits any enemy within 3" at Strength 1; the distance and Strength rise by 1 at the start of each of your turns up to 7" and Strength 5. No range or cover penalties, wounds as usual, no critical hits.

items.name: Evil Jester Mask
items.note: Cursed Mask. At the start of the battle roll a D12: 1-2 subject to Stupidity for the battle; 3-11 hates all enemies for the battle; 12 Frenzy.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.text: Any warrior of the Cavalcade warband within 6" of the Aristocrat may use his Leadership value when taking Leadership tests.

specialRules.name: Expert Horseman
specialRules.text: Has the Ride (Nightmare) skill.

specialRules.name: Expert Swordsman
specialRules.text: All Companions have the Expert Swordsman skill.

fighters.name: Twisted Scholar

specialRules.name: Magical Adept
specialRules.text: When hiring, pay 10 additional gc to upgrade to a Wizard; he uses Lesser Magic and knows 1 spell chosen randomly.

specialRules.name: Story Teller
specialRules.text: When hiring, if not upgraded to a Wizard, pay 10 additional gc to make him a Chronicler: in the Exploration phase he may reroll an extra die and decide which of the two dice to keep.

fighters.notes: Base cost 25; Wizard (Lesser Magic) and Chronicler are +10 gc upgrades, mutually exclusive, so he is a spellcaster only if the upgrade is bought.

fighters.name: Cursed Piper

specialRules.name: Danse Macabre
specialRules.text: In the shooting phase the Piper can direct his flute against one enemy model he can see within 6". It must pass a Leadership test or be cursed: the Piper can move it in any direction he wishes (including out of close combat or to fall from height). At the start of the enemy's turn in the recovery phase it must pass a Leadership test or remain under the Piper's control and cannot shoot, charge or cast spells. If engaged in close combat the model cannot attack. Only one enemy at a time; targeting another frees the previous one.

fighters.notes: Must hold a flute or other one-handed instrument; may not use an off-hand weapon, double-handed weapon, brace of pistols, Bows or Crossbows.

fighters.name: Captured Thrall

specialRules.name: Extra servitors, worthless, but still precious
specialRules.text: Captured Thralls do not count toward the maximum number of models allowed in your warband, effectively increasing the maximum capacity from 13 to 18. You cannot dismiss any Captured Thrall.

specialRules.name: Not really clever
specialRules.text: Captured Thralls cannot earn experience points and therefore cannot gain any advancement.

fighters.notes: Cannot be hired: obtained only through Capture! / Throne of Worms (cost 0 recorded; PDF lists no price). Does not count toward the model limit.

fighters.name: Great Bear
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never uses weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Maddened With Pain
specialRules.text: As soon as the Great Bear suffers a single wound it gains an additional attack.

specialRules.name: Large Target
specialRules.text: Great Bears are Large Targets.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.text: Animal; never gains experience.

fighters.notes: Menagerie henchmen are bought in groups of 1-5.

fighters.name: Wild Beast
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never uses weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Charge
specialRules.text: When charging, gains +1 Attack on the first turn of close combat.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.text: Animal; never gains experience.

fighters.name: Fighting Ape
fixedEquipment: Natural weapons (never uses weapons or armour)

specialRules.name: Cymbals
specialRules.text: May be given a pair of cymbals for 15 gc: any enemy model within 6" suffers -1 BS and Ld.

specialRules.name: Agile
specialRules.text: Has the Scale Sheer Surfaces, Acrobat and Dodge skills, and can make a diving charge from up to 10" high.

specialRules.name: Animal
specialRules.text: Animal; never gains experience, but can still climb and enter buildings as normal.

fighters.notes: Cymbals (15 gc) are an optional purchase not in any equipment list.

Special.name: Noblesse Obliges
Special.text: Immune to fear and can stomp opponents who are knocked down with iron-shod boots: an additional attack against knocked down opponents at his own Strength.

Special.name: Torturer
Special.text: Any model successfully wounded (and not saved) in close combat by this Hero loses 1 point of Strength for the rest of the battle, cumulative to a minimum of 1. The Undead are immune.

Special.name: Duelist
Special.text: At the end of each Close Combat phase, may force any non-large opponent he is fighting one-on-one to pass a Strength test or be pushed 2" in any direction chosen by the Duelist. If this brings the target into contact with another model, both suffer an automatic Strength 2 hit. If pushed off a high place the opponent falls and takes damage as normal. The duelist stays on the elevated area.

conversionNotes: Throne of Worms (1d6 table) converted to 1d12 using the schema rules: 1 -> 1-2, 6 -> natural 12, remaining 2-5 -> 3-11. Evil Jester Mask roll converted the same way (1 -> 1-2, 2-5 -> 3-11, 6 -> 12).
Boar Spear price conflict: equipment list says 30 gc, item description says 20 gc; 30 used as listCost.

Banner of the Noble House (25 gc, Rare 10, Leadership +1 up to 10 for the bearer; models within 12" reroll failed All Alone tests while bearer is not knocked down, stunned or fleeing) is described but not in any equipment list, so it is not included as an item.
Cursed Masks are in the Heroes equipment list as misc items; one free mask per hero at warband creation (unique per warband), Sun King Mask Aristocrat only, Plague Doctor Mask Twisted Scholar only.
Twisted Scholar: spellcaster 'Lesser Magic' only if the +10 gc Magical Adept upgrade is purchased; the alternative +10 gc upgrade is Chronicler.
Max 13 models initially; Captured Thralls (0-5, cannot be hired) lift the cap to 18. Captured Thrall cost recorded as 0.
Special skill list is custom and stored in the extra top-level skillLists field. Heroes' skills include 'Special' per the skill table.
Wild Beast A printed '2(3)'; stored as 2 with the charge bonus in its special rule. Fighting Ape profile is identical to Wild Beast except A and I as printed.
Lance and Nightmare/Banner mounts rely on rulebook mounted rules not included in the PDF.
